data.title: 五和 · 客厅榻榻米上的热毛巾悉心照料
data.description: 温馨的单身公寓榻榻米上，围着围裙的五和跪坐在你身前，双手捧着冒着白气的热毛巾，温柔地为你擦拭脸颊与双手。少女眼波如水，满面通红却透着令人心融的极度贤惠。
data.location: warm domestic tatami living room with steaming kettle
data.action: kneeling on tatami, gently wiping partner face and hands with a warm steaming towel, blushing furiously with tender devoted eyes
data.lighting: warm amber indoor lantern light casting tender glows on flushed cheeks
data.mood: unrivaled traditional Japanese wife devotion, sweet healing comfort, heartwarming intimacy
data.promptProse: Kneeling on tatami in a green apron, Itsuwa gently wipes partner face with a warm steaming towel, blushing with immense tender devotion.
data.animaCaption: Itsuwa gently wiping partner face with warm towel in apron.
